description: AKS node pools now support a configurable OS SKU (such as `AzureLinux`) via a mutable `AksNodePoolConfig` passed to `WithSystemNodePool` and `AddNodePool` callbacks, without needing to edit generated Bicep that deployment would later regenerate. Polyglot (TypeScript, Python, Java) node-pool configuration now uses a configuration callback instead of a scalar options object or keyword arguments.
name: Configurable AKS node pool OS SKU
